sections.heading: Effect
sections.markdown:
Manifests a spectral greatsword from with 220 Magic base damage that is then used in an overhead slash.

Can be charged up to two more times for more damage, first to 315 base damage and then to 400 base damage.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.markdown:
- Costs 30 points of Stamina to use when not charged, 40 points of Stamina when charged once, and 60 points of Stamina when charged twice.
- As a Magic-based skill it benefits from the Spellblade's Set damage bonus.
- As a bullet-type skill it scales with the weapon's upgrade level and the wielder's Intelligence.
 - Gains increased Intelligence-scaling from the Magic and Cold affinities.
 - The Carian Knight's Sword has scaling on par with Magic affinity weapon, dealing only 0.5% less damage when fully upgraded and at 80 Intelligence.
- Damage is increased by 15% by the Godfrey Icon if charged.
 - Since the second and third levels already increase damage by 43% and by 82% of the uncharged base damage, this increases their damage increases to 65% and 109% respectively
- Compared to the Carian Greatsword skill this skill deals equal damage when uncharged but less damage when charged once (315 base damage compared to the Carian Greatsword's 340 base damage) but charges quicker and deals more than the Carian Greatsword at the highest charge level.
- Since the skill takes a bit to charge and requires the user to be stationary, this skill is best used in place of a Critical Attack or when ambushing an enemy.
 - It's also possible to time the charging so that it can be used just as an enemy steps into its reach, though this is considerably harder.
 - When fighting other players, consider varying which stage is used to surprise them, especially if they are about to perform an action such as attacking.
-

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.markdown:
- Patch 1.04 increased cast speed and decreased recovery time, increased the damage when charge (sic) and made it easier to cause enemies to flinch.
 - Increased the base damage when charged once from 280 to 315, and the base damage when charged twice from 350 to 400.

sections.heading: Acquisition

- Can be applied to infusable weapons with Ash of War: Gravitas.
- Found as the innate skill on the Meteoric Ore Blade.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.markdown: Stabs the weapon into the ground and draws nearby enemies in with a magical implosion.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.markdown:
- Costs 13 FP.
- Causes 26 Stance damage, on par with a jumping heavy attack for the heavier weapons (Greatswords, Colossal Swords, Curved Greatswords, Heavy Thrusting Swords, Greataxes, Hammers, Great Hammers, Colossal Weapons, Great Spears) and on par with a charged heavy attack for the rest.
- Both the stab and the implosion are attacks. The former causes the same damage type as your weapon while the implosion causes Magic damage.
- The implosion scales with the user's Intelligence and the weapon's upgrade level, with a small (roughly 10%) additional damage boost if the weapon has the Magic affinity selected.
- The implosion actually consists of three overlapping waves with different ranges. This means that those standing furthest out only take damage from one wave, those standing in the middle take damage from two waves, and those standing furthest in take damage from all three waves.
 - This stacking of separate damage sources does unfortunately mean that the damage of the skill will be heavily blunted by enemies' flat defences early on.
- Fairly effective for farming items from weak animals, since it has a decently large area-of-effect and will bring their bodies closer to you.
- As stated by Note: Gravity's Advantage, this skill draws down flying enemies, such as the Warhawks that dot the rooftops of Stormveil Castle, onto the ground.

sections.heading: Acquisition
sections.markdown:
- Can be granted to infusable weapons of certain weapon types with the Ash of War: Sacred Blade.
- Innate skill of the Inseparable Sword and Miquellan Knight's Sword.

sections.heading: Effects
sections.markdown:
Sweeps the weapon forward, launching a wave of Holy light.

Grants a Weapon Buff giving 90 bonus Holy damage for 40 seconds.

All parts of this skill also causes 100% bonus damage against Those Who Live in Death and prevents Skeletons from resurrecting.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.markdown:
- The wave and the swipe gain a 10% damage boost if used with a weapon that has the Sacred affinity.
- Since both the weapon and the wave causes damage, this skill causes much more damage up close.
- The wave's damage scales with weapon upgrade level and the user's Faith, and the swipe scales with the weapon's damage.
 - The wave gains increased Faith-scaling depending on how strong the weapon's own Faith-scaling is, whether that be innate or from the Sacred affinity.
- Causes incredible damage against undead foes such as Death Rite Bird, even with no investment in Faith as long as the weapon is upgraded well.
 - The 100% damage bonus against Those Who Live in Death granted by the Weapon Buff applies to all of the weapon's damage, not just the bonus Holy damage from the buff itself.
- Besides the Sacred Order skill, this skill is the only way to increase the Holy damage of Sacred affinity weapons directly.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.markdown:
- Patch 1.04 increased the cast speed of this skill.
- Patch 1.07 increased motion speed and range of the (sacred) blade, added damage detection to the weapon part, and increased effect duration and attack power that gives the weapon holy power.
 - The second line means that the swing of the weapon itself also causes damage after the patch, and the third line means that the duration of the Weapon Buff was increased from 20 seconds to 40 seconds and that the additional damage was increased from 85 to 90.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.markdown: Skill: Poison Moth Flight** is a Skill in Elden Ring.

sections.heading: Effect
sections.markdown: The user's readies the blade before lunging forward, slashing to deal 250 Poison build up and "detonates" any Poison inflicted on an enemy for damage equal to 250 plus 5% of that enemy's maximum health.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.markdown:
- Cannot apply and detonate poison in the same usage, even if its own hit would apply Poison.
- The default status buildup scales somewhat with Arcane, with greater scaling on an Occult-affinity weapon.
- Since the damage is the same regardless of how much duration is left on the Poison, it is generally best to wait out the duration a bit, especially if the Poison is of the more powerful Deadly variant.
- Besides the obvious use of getting more damage on a Poisoned enemy, it can also be used to more easily keep up the damage buff from Kindred of Rot's Exultation and Mushroom Crown, especially so if using regular Poison.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.markdown:
- Patch 1.04 increased cast speed and decreased recovery time of this skill.
- Patch 1.07 increased poison status buildup and its power against poisoned enemies, increased the duration and damage of poison, and reduced the delay between the end of various actions (such as using items or attack animations) and being able to perform the skill.
